prompt_mode_reason: the tokenizer declares a non-empty chat_template, so the checkpoint is chat/instruct and the suite is rendered with apply_chat_template
chat_template_note: the rendered system message embeds the current date, so the exact prompt text is date-dependent; the token ids recorded in qualitative_prompts.json are what both arms ran
endpoint_note: the pinned chat-rendered token ids are posted directly as `prompt`, so the server runs exactly the input the HF control and the previous TT stages ran; sending text would let the server re-render the date-dependent system message and move the comparison
